title: The impact of role clarity on sustainable careers for EdAdvisors in Australian higher education
venue: Journal of Higher Education Policy and Management

annotation.summary: The sustainability of third space careers appears to be influenced by poor understanding of these roles and inconsistent use of titles across the sector
annotation.method: Drew from 16 interviews and surveys with 183 EdAdvisors in 41 Australian universities
annotation.evaluation: Compelling arguments from a leader in 3rd space research
